verdict.rationale: Belvo's own pricing page says it offers a sandbox environment made for testing that exposes its full API, which addresses the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, though, with no developer documentation on how the sandbox works or how it is separated from production. missing for 10: developer docs describing sandbox setup and separate sandbox credentials or environment URLs, explicit statement of isolation from production data, sandbox test institutions or test data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Explore Belvo's full API in a sandbox environment made for testing
